documents.title: Privacy Policy
documents.body:
WHO WE ARE
GroverHQ ("we", "us") is a company based in India. Contact: info@groverhq.com.

THE SHORT VERSION
GroverHQ Camera Viewer works entirely on your TV and your local network. We do not collect your personal information. The app does not send your data to us or to any server run by us - we do not run any servers for this app.

WHAT THE APP HANDLES ON YOUR TV
- Camera details: the IP address, port, username and password of a camera or recorder that you enter or select. If you choose "Save this camera", they are stored on this TV only. Saved passwords are encrypted (AES-256-GCM) before they are written to the TV's storage.
- Video: streamed directly from your camera or recorder to your TV, decoded and shown on screen. The app does not record, save, upload or share video.
- Network scan: when you press Scan, the app checks addresses on your own local network for cameras. The results are shown on screen only.
- App settings: whether you accepted these documents, whether the paid unlock is active, and which devices refused a login. These are stored on this TV only.

WHAT LEAVES YOUR TV
Nothing is sent to us. The app connects only to the cameras and recorders you choose (using RTSP and ONVIF), at the address you enter or select.

PURCHASES
If you buy the paid unlock, the payment is handled entirely by Samsung Checkout. We never see your card or payment details. To connect your purchase to your Samsung account (so it can be restored after a reinstall or on another TV), the app passes your Samsung account identifier to Samsung Checkout and to nobody else. We use it only for that purpose, we do not store it or send it anywhere else, and it travels over a secure connection. Samsung's privacy policy applies to the payment.

WHAT WE DO NOT DO
No accounts, no analytics, no advertising identifiers, no tracking, no third-party advertising networks. The message strip at the bottom of the free version is fixed text stored inside the app.

CHILDREN
The app is not directed at children and does not knowingly collect any information from anyone.

RETENTION AND DELETION
Everything the app stores is on your TV. Delete a saved camera in the app, or uninstall the app, and the data is removed.

CHANGES
If this policy changes in a material way, the app will ask you to read and accept it again.

CONTACT
Questions or requests: info@groverhq.com.

documents.title: Terms of Use
documents.body:
1. ACCEPTANCE
By accepting these terms and using GroverHQ Camera Viewer ("the app") you agree to them. If you do not agree, please exit the app and uninstall it.

2. WHAT THE APP DOES
The app lets you watch live video from IP cameras and network video recorders on your own network, one stream at a time. It is a live viewer only: it does not record, play back or seek. It works with cameras that offer RTSP video (H.264 or H.265), and cannot be guaranteed to work with every camera or recorder.

3. FREE AND PAID USE
The free version plays the lower-resolution stream with a moving watermark. The paid unlock removes the watermark and allows the higher-resolution stream. The paid unlock is a monthly subscription sold through Samsung Checkout; the price, including any taxes, is shown in Samsung Checkout before you buy. It renews every month until you cancel it in your Samsung account's subscription settings. Payments, cancellations and refunds are handled by Samsung Checkout under Samsung's terms. Prices and features may change; a change to the subscription price will be shown by Samsung before you are charged.

4. YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES
You must use the app lawfully and read the Lawful Use Notice. You are responsible for the cameras you connect, for the security of your network and camera passwords, and for anything done with your TV.

5. NOT A SAFETY OR ALARM SYSTEM
Video may be delayed by several seconds and may fail or stop at any time. Do not rely on the app for security, alarms, life-safety, medical or any other critical purpose.

6. NO WARRANTY
The app is provided "as is" and "as available", without warranties of any kind, to the extent permitted by law. We do not promise it will be uninterrupted, error-free, or compatible with your equipment.

7. LIMITATION OF LIABILITY
To the extent permitted by law, we are not liable for indirect or consequential loss, loss of data, or loss arising from use of the app or from what is seen or not seen through it. Our total liability for any claim is limited to the amount you paid for the app in the twelve months before the claim.

8. CHANGES AND ENDING
We may update these terms or the app. If a change is material, the app will ask you to accept again. You may stop using the app at any time. We may stop offering the app or limit access if these terms are broken.

9. THIRD PARTIES
Samsung, Tizen and Samsung Checkout are trademarks of Samsung. GroverHQ is not part of Samsung. Camera brands and names belong to their owners.

10. GOVERNING LAW
These terms are governed by the laws of India. Courts at Mohali, Punjab have jurisdiction, subject to any consumer rights you have that cannot be excluded.

11. CONTACT
info@groverhq.com

documents.title: Security Policy
documents.body:
HOW WE PROTECT YOUR DATA
- Saved camera passwords are encrypted with AES-256-GCM before being written to the TV's storage, inside the app's private data area.
- Passwords are never written to logs. The released app contains no diagnostic logging and no network tracing.
- The app has no server component and sends no data to us, so there is no central store of your camera details that could be breached.

HOW THE APP USES THE NETWORK
- It connects only to cameras and recorders that you choose.
- The optional network scan sends short connection probes only to addresses on your own local network.
- To protect your cameras from lockouts, the app stops after a wrong password instead of retrying repeatedly, and it does not retry a device that has refused an ONVIF login.

WHAT YOU SHOULD KNOW
Most cameras send video and login details over your local network without encryption (this is how RTSP and ONVIF normally work). Anyone on the same network could potentially observe that traffic. To stay safe:
- Use a private network you trust; keep cameras off guest Wi-Fi.
- Change the default username and password on every camera and recorder.
- Ask your camera provider to give your cameras fixed IP addresses and to keep their firmware up to date.
- Do not expose your cameras to the internet.

REPORTING A VULNERABILITY
Please write to info@groverhq.com with the details. We will respond as soon as we can.

documents.title: Lawful Use Notice
documents.body:
This app can show live video of homes, businesses and people. You alone are responsible for using it lawfully.

- Only connect cameras that you own, or that you have clear permission to view.
- Never use the app to watch someone without their knowledge or consent, or to access a camera on a network you are not authorised to use.
- Follow the privacy, data-protection and surveillance laws that apply where you and the camera are, including rules about recording, notices and signage, and cameras that cover shared or private spaces.
- Only scan networks that belong to you or that you are permitted to test.
- Keep camera passwords private, and do not share what you see on screen with people who are not entitled to see it.
- If you are an installer or manager, make sure the owners of the cameras and the people they film have agreed to this use.

We do not see, store or control your video and cannot check that your use is lawful. We are not responsible for how you use the app. Misuse may be a criminal offence.

Questions: info@groverhq.com
